title: Lease Report Schema
description: JSON Schema for Statuz Lease Report — progress and status update from an assignee on an active lease

lease_id.description: Reference to the Lease being reported on (e.g., ls-001)

reported_at.description: ISO timestamp when this report was created

status.description: Current status of the lease (e.g., active, blocked, on_track)

progress_summary.description: Text summary of progress since the last report or lease creation

next_steps.description: Next planned actions the assignee will take

evidence.description: File paths or references supporting the progress claim
